nom: Clinique Redness Solutions Daily Relief Face Cream With Probiotic Technology

segments.sensitive: Reviewers repeatedly describe very sensitive or reactive skin, and most report the cream calms and soothes it without burning, though a minority say it broke them out, stung, or made redness worse.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report the cream is hydrating and helps with tightness and flaking, with one calling it rich yet oil-free.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination oily/acne-prone skin found it moisturizing without being too heavy or breaking her out.
segments.mature: Older reviewers (50s-70s) report long-term comfort and reduced redness appearance, using it alongside separate anti-aging products at night.
segments.oily: One reviewer with oily skin says it hydrates without making her skin oilier.

concerns.redness: The large majority of reviewers, many with diagnosed rosacea, report visible reduction in redness, often within days, and several use it long-term as their only effective solution; a notable minority say it did nothing for their redness or even made it worse, and one calls it not a redness coverup.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers describe a compromised or impaired barrier with flaking, stinging and tightness that improved with use, but one long-time user reports the reformulated product (containing sodium hyaluronate) now irritates and destroys her barrier.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report no breakouts and some say it clears painful bumps, but a few describe new whitehead breakouts or comodegenic reactions, particularly on acne-prone skin.
concerns.spots: One reviewer with rosacea reports fewer red bumps after use.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers with dry or dehydrated skin report the cream provides lasting moisture and relieves tightness and flaking, with hydration described as lasting over 24 hours by one user.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer states it hydrates without increasing oiliness on oily skin.
concerns.aging: One mature reviewer uses this cream in the morning and pairs it with a separate anti-aging cream at night, without commenting on anti-aging effects from this product itself.

extraits.texte: I LOVE Clinique, I am a faithful user of moisture surge and all about eyes, as well as the 7 day scrub for years and years now. I was excited to try this cream because I have sensitive skin and mild rosacea and read great reviews, plus I love Clinique, but unfortunately woke up with tiny little puss white head dots (easily poppable) all over my face in the morning and it turned more red/aggravated. I might be allergic to an ingredient? I wouldn't recommend this if you have acne prone skin!!! I changed nothing else in my routine and haven't had a breakout in over a decade.

This used to be my holy grail of a moisturizer. It calmed and cleared my skin so well, it was amazing. Over the last year or two I noticed that it wasn't calming my skin, my skin didn't feel hydrated while using it, and it wasn't helping with redness. Turns out hyaluronic acid completely irritates and destroys my skin barrier and I can't use it. Unfortunately this has sodium hyaluronate and I can no longer use it after almost 8 years of using it. I'm so incredibly disappointed since my skin is so sensitive and this was one of the very few products I could use on it.

extraits.titre: Reduces redness and locks in moisture so well
extraits.texte: First off, this cream is the only cream I can use without my skin reacting and my skin reacts to everything, even Avene tolerance control cream, which has only like 6 ingredients! This cream reduces redness very well and also moisturizes like a dream, better than cerave cream for flaking skin. It leaves the skin so soft, supple, and smooth and the hydration lasts more than 24 hours. When my skin was flaking due to impaired barrier, it quickly reduces the flaking and stops the stinging and tightness of impaired barrier. I've used this for years and my skin always feel better in this cream.

My skin is extremely sensitive with rosacea and eczema. My face burns and gets red usually midday when the sun is at its peak. I have used several prescriptions from the dermatologist (several I can't use because they burn) and they give minimal results…as well as drugstore creams and lotions. It is difficult for me to find something moisturizing enough that doesn't break me out because on top of my other skin concerns my skin is combination oily/acne prone, it's super fun!!! < not> This product works so well, even though it's priced high I feel like it's really soothed and moisturized my skin better than any other moisturizer, while also not being too heavy. I feel like my skin texture is even changing- it's smoother, the pores are reduced and more even tone. While I still get some redness if it's a really sunny day, it's not as bad and doesn't burn as badly. I'm on the hunt for the best mineral sunscreen to help combat this (chemical sunscreens burn). Currently using the EltaMD UV physical which I love and looks great but going to try something with a higher spf to see if that makes a difference. I hope this review is helpful for anyone else struggling with very sensitive redness-prone skin!!!

extraits.titre: Outstanding for my dry, acne, rosacea prone skin!
extraits.texte: I cannot recommend this enough if you are dealing with dry, red, sensitive acne and rosacea prone skin! I have been dealing with all of these, and tried sooooo many things and the Redness Solutions line products are the best by far that work very well for me. Love it so much!

According to picture of the redness solutions cream, it's texture is rich and thick. The product I received has very light texture.I have redness and acne on my cheeks and this cream doesn't soothe my skin. It felt a little bit spicy after applying the product on face and there were more breakouts the next day after I using the redness solutions cream. It may not suit people with sensitive skin like me
I have very sensitive skin, and although this is not a redness coverup, it does lessen redness and is so soothing and moisturizing to my very dry skin.
